title: Splitting a Polynomial into Linear Factors after an Injective Ring Extension
summary: We show that each univariate polynomial $P = p_0 + p_1 X + \cdots + p_m X^m \in R[X]$ over a commutative ring $R$ can be factored into linear factors over a suitable commutative ring extension $S$ of $R$.
